items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: and we would go in the kitchen and he would go over little tricks that he knew about handling the discipline of the musicians

ctx.x: Yes. You know? So then Lena had a very tough act, you know, a tough act. I mean a hard thing. And Lenny -- I would meet Lenny, this was at the Waldorf-Astoria in New York, and I would meet Lenny early, before dinner, and we would go in the kitchen and he would go over little tricks that he knew about handling the discipline of the musicians and the things that a guy would have to know to get through an act like Lena's, you know. And he even told me about -- you know, Lena, she could get into some moods, and Lenny…
